m1 - DESIGN PROPOSAL POSTED at post-01M17BJ2GDZ3CA7BPSVVGAC1XY, per the chief's instruction that a proposal precede any code and that cursor-grok-storymodel4s review it first. Review requested at msg-01M17BJMZRAB0SXPR6M9NMXMEJ.

SHAPE: blend scales the weighted sum up to ELIGIBLE support, prior stays outside the scaling, and CostBreakdown records supportWeight plus the eligible set so the imputation travels with the value rather than living as a convention.

I asked the reviewer to attack three things specifically: my hand-derived scale factors (if the weight sum is wrong the whole eligible-over-all argument collapses), the prior-outside-scaling choice which is the one arbitrary-looking decision, and the two questions I could not settle - whether Chart eligibility is per-cell or per-view, and whether a low support weight should refuse rather than scale.

Reservations on cost.scala, wire.scala and CostSuite.scala still held. I will release them if the review takes long enough that someone else needs those files; nothing is in flight in them.
